tools.name: cheapest_destinations
tools.description: Find cached indicative fares and filter destinations locally by geography, climate, coast, island, elevation or terrain relief, beach or hiking traits, culture, parks, population, connectivity, and route trip-duration suitability. Use population_level=low for quieter small-city options, but note that it is a global population band, not a measure of crowds or tourism: a small city may still be busy with visitors. Other low/medium/high values are also global bands, not ranks within a country; museum_level=low means no notable museum signal, not no museums. National-park distance is to the park centre. Monthly air and water filters require month. Prices are per adult. Always link the returned search_url from a short label; never paste the raw URL.

air_temp_min.description: Minimum monthly air temperature in degrees Celsius. Requires month and excludes destinations without air-temperature data.

country.description: Two-letter destination country filter, applied locally.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

elevation_min_m.description: Minimum destination elevation above sea level in metres, applied locally. Use for mountain or high-altitude requests such as 'I want to go to the mountains' or 'хочу в горы'.

group.description: Curated destination group, applied locally. asia: cities in selected Asian countries. schengen: cities in the Schengen area. russia: domestic Russian destinations. Use the separate measured coast, monthly temperature, island, and elevation filters for those traits; do not infer unsupported themes.

island.description: When true, return tourist island destinations rather than dense urban island districts or continent-sized landmasses. Use for requests such as 'take me to an island' or 'куда на острова'.

limit.description: Maximum number of destinations to return, applied locally.

locale.description: Language locale for reference names and response text.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

max_coast_distance_km.description: Maximum destination-city distance to the coast in kilometres, applied locally from the Aviasurf destination knowledge base.

max_national_park_distance_km.description: Maximum distance to a national park centre in kilometres.

museum_level_min.description: Minimum global museum band; low means no notable museum signal, not no museums.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

population_level.description: Exact global population band; use low for quieter small-city options, not as a crowd or tourism measure.

sort.description: Sort by indicative price or preserve upstream popularity order.

subregion.description: UN M49 destination subregion in lowercase snake_case, applied locally.

terrain_relief_min_m.description: Minimum surrounding terrain relief in metres.

trip_duration_band.description: Route-suitability band from the destination knowledge base. Use weekend for requests such as 'weekend getaway' or 'куда на выходные'; use the other bands for an explicitly requested trip length.

water_temp_min.description: Minimum monthly water temperature in degrees Celsius. Use with month for requests such as 'where can I swim?' or 'где можно купаться'; destinations without water data are excluded.

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: Compare cached indicative fare samples in an interactive airport comparison across airports of the origin city, destination city, or both. Prices are per adult. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. Outbound and inbound are calculated separately. Missing prices mean no cached observation, not that no flight exists.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

depart_date.description: Optional exact departure date. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_month.

depart_month.description: Optional departure month. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_date.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

direction.description: Compare outbound routes, inbound routes, or both independently.

locale.description: Language locale for airport and airline names and response text.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

return_date.description: Optional return date for outbound price comparisons.

side.description: Expand airports on the origin side, destination side, or both.

tools.name: destination_profile
tools.description: Use this tool when the user asks what a place is like, when to visit, how warm its air or water is, how far the coast is, what national parks or museums are nearby, or when comparing destinations before choosing one. Climate values are 1991–2020 normals, not a forecast. Beach objects are not available; the tool provides only distance to the coastline and the derived beach_destination trait, meaning the coast is within 10 km and at least one month has water warmer than 20 °C. The nearest national park distance is measured to the park centre, not an entrance or boundary. museum_level=low means no notable museum signal, not that there are no museums. Missing fields mean the source has no measurement; do not invent values.

locale.description: Language locale for response text and the destination widget.

tools.name: flight_prices
tools.description: Find cached indicative 'from' fares for a route and render interactive flight cards. Prices are per adult. These are historical observations, not live availability or booking offers. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

depart_date.description: Optional exact departure date. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_month.

depart_month.description: Optional departure month. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_date.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

limit.description: Maximum number of public fare items to return.

locale.description: Language locale for names and response text.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

one_way.description: Search a one-way trip; inferred from return_date when omitted.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

return_date.description: Optional return date for a round trip.

tools.name: flight_prices_filtered
tools.description: Find cached indicative fares with baggage, cabin, direct-flight, budget, flexible-date, and trip-duration filters and render interactive flight cards. Prices are per adult. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. Airline, departure-time, and transfer-count filters are applied only to the returned cache sample and are reported in query_coverage. Use flight_prices for requests that do not need these filters.

airlines.description: Allowed airline IATA codes, applied locally to the returned sample.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

departure_time_max.description: Latest local departure time in HH:MM format, applied locally.

departure_time_min.description: Earliest local departure time in HH:MM format, applied locally.

direct.description: Ask upstream for nonstop options only.

locale.description: Language locale for names and response text.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

no_visa_at_transfer.description: Exclude itineraries flagged as requiring a transit visa.

one_way.description: Search one-way trips; inferred from return constraints when omitted.

pairs.description: One to three origin/destination pairs to search in one batch.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

transfers_max.description: Maximum number of transfers, applied locally to the returned sample.

trip_class.description: Cabin class; human-readable names are preferred and Y/W/C/F are accepted aliases.

trip_duration_max.description: Maximum trip length in days for round trips.

trip_duration_min.description: Minimum trip length in days for round trips.

value_max.description: Maximum indicative price in the requested currency.

value_min.description: Minimum indicative price in the requested currency.

with_baggage.description: Ask upstream for options marked as including baggage.

tools.name: open_search
tools.description: Build an Aviasurf live-search URL with dates, passenger composition, cabin class, currency, and locale. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. This opens live search; it does not confirm a fare or availability.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

depart_date.description: Optional departure date to prefill in live search.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

locale.description: Language locale for the live search page.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

return_date.description: Optional return date to prefill in live search.

trip_class.description: Cabin class; human-readable names are preferred and Y/W/C/F are accepted aliases.

tools.name: price_calendar
tools.description: Show cached indicative price observations in an interactive calendar by day, by month, or as observed departure/return date pairs. Prices are per adult. Every monthly row includes sample_size and sample_sufficient. A month with sample_sufficient=false is a limited cached observation, not a reliable monthly minimum or evidence of seasonality; state that limitation instead of drawing a seasonal conclusion. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. Missing dates mean no cached observation, not that no flight exists.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

depart_date.description: Center date for the local plus-or-minus three-day window.

depart_month.description: Month for a daily calendar or observed date pairs.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

group_by.description: Calendar mode: daily departures, monthly minima, or observed round-trip date pairs.

locale.description: Language locale for response text and live-search handoff.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

months_ahead.description: Number of months including the current partial month for month mode.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

top_n.description: Maximum number of cheapest dates to include in top_dates.

trip_duration_max.description: Maximum trip length in days for observed date pairs.

trip_duration_min.description: Minimum trip length in days for observed date pairs.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve a city, airport, or country name to IATA/location candidates. Returns every plausible candidate instead of guessing, and includes airports for city candidates.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

locale.description: Language locale for returned place names.

query.description: Place name or IATA code to resolve.

types.description: Place types to include in the candidates.

Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. direct_seen means only that a nonstop option appeared in the sample; never infer that direct flights do not exist.

depart_date.description: Optional exact departure date. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_month.

depart_month.description: Optional departure month. Omit both date fields for the cheapest observations across the cached horizon; do not combine with depart_date.
